message:
docs(tasks): add measured-bandwidth adaptive quality as a core code item (C0)

The encoder can produce FHD60, but nothing measures the link's available bandwidth, so setting a
high target just stalls. Today's ABR (host_abr.hpp AbrInputs) only reacts after the fact -- to
client fps, latency, UDP drop and rtt -- and there is no bandwidth estimate anywhere in the plan or
the code; it is essentially ping and loss. The user asked for a real network-speed measurement so
the quality setting becomes a ceiling the runtime flexibly drops below, rather than a fixed value
that freezes the stream.

Added as C0 (core): continuous bandwidth estimation (send pacing plus receive inter-arrival and
delay trend, the WebRTC GCC family of delay- and loss-based control), ABR clamping bitrate to
min(user ceiling, estimate x margin) with conservative start, upward probing and back-off before
loss, and an initial estimate at connect for the starting bitrate. Flagged that it adds a bandwidth
feedback signal to the protocol, so it needs Codex sign-off, and placed after the connection
stability items (C1, C2).

제품/테스트/문서: 문서만.
